name: Pension Haus Rief
beschreibung:
Overview

Haus Elfi Rief, also run as “3 Edelweiß Haus Rief”, is a family-run guesthouse in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal in Tyrol. The hosts Elfi and Bernd Rief rent out a holiday apartment for two to four people – the roughly 40 m² Apartment 1 with a balcony and views of the Gaichtspitze and the Rot Flüh – as well as a bright double room with breakfast in the cosy farmhouse parlour. These are non-smoking accommodations. The house is child-friendly for families; according to the provider, a playground, cross-country ski trail, lift, cycle path, lake and high ropes course are nearby. Amenities include cable TV, internet access, a safe, garden furniture, a large sunbathing lawn, a barbecue hut, a TV room, a balcony with seating, and storage space for bicycles, motorcycles and skis as well as a shoe dryer. In summer, the mountain railways in the Tannheimer Tal are included, as is admission to the Haldensee open-air pool.

History/Background

On Tyrol's official tourism portals, the house is listed as a room or private accommodation and as a holiday apartment in the “3 Edelweiß” category in Nesselwängle. The operator is Elfi Rief, who appears together with Bernd Rief as hostess and host. The available sources give no information on a founding year or previous owners, so reliable historical details are not documented.

Getting there

By car, the Tannheimer Tal and thus Nesselwängle can be reached from the north, among other routes, via Ulm – Kempten – Oy with the Oberjoch exit; according to the provider, this route requires no vignette. From Switzerland the route leads via Lindau – Sonthofen or via the Arlberg – Landeck – Fernpass – Reutte – Weißenbach into the valley; from Italy or Vienna via Innsbruck – Mötz – Fernpass – Reutte – Weißenbach or via Rosenheim – Bad Tölz – Garmisch-Partenkirchen – Reutte – Weißenbach. The nearest railway stations with bus connections are Sonthofen (around 24 km), Pfronten/Ried (around 16 km) and Reutte (around 24 km). The nearest airports are Memmingen (around 84 km), Innsbruck (around 120 km), Munich (around 200 km) as well as Stuttgart and Zurich (around 220 km each).

Tips

Arrival is possible from 1:00 p.m.; the accommodation must be vacated by 10:00 a.m. For Apartment 1, daily rates in summer and winter are 80.00 euros for two, 96.00 euros for three and 105.00 euros for four people; the double room with breakfast costs 55.00 euros per person. There is a discount in the low season, and a final cleaning fee of 30.00 euros applies. On request, fresh bread from the in-house bakery is delivered (roll service; only the bread is charged). Free cancellation is possible up to three months before arrival; staggered conditions apply thereafter. The place of performance and jurisdiction is Reutte.

Best time to travel

The house is offered equally as a holiday destination for summer and winter and is described as a destination “for every season”. The warm season suits hikers and mountaineers, while in winter the cross-country ski trail and lift are nearby. The sources do not specify a particular seasonal operation or fixed opening hours.
